method: Read all observed and timing claims with complete quoted source text; checked ownership, ordinal, target, stated values, arithmetic, and inference qualifiers. Spot-checked final non-observed event per account. No legacy reconstruction data used.
limitations: Exact quote matching to owned source spans is handled by parent.

Generic note text sometimes says values omitted even on populated records, but record values and quotes are supported; no data issue found.
